ocr.notes: Mostly right; Mace's letter has a few garbled words ('fight / n' for 'fight Allen').

title.suggested: Coburn Seeks Wrestling Match with Bauer

summary.suggested: The St. Louis Globe-Democrat reported that Joe Coburn, newly arrived after Tom Allen's departure, offered a $250 forfeit to wrestle Theobaud Bauer, and printed a letter from Jem Mace saying Joe Goss was coming to fight Allen.

metadata.notes: Masthead: St. Louis Daily Globe-Democrat, Monday Morning, April 17, 1876, page 5.

facts.fact: The paper said Allen and old Bill Ryall first came to America in 1868
Jem Mace wrote from London that Joe Goss was coming to America principally to fight Allen, sailing with Mace from Liverpool on March 25, 1876

notes: The current title ('Mace and Allen Championship Contest') is wrong; the article is about Coburn and Bauer. The 1868 arrival date conflicts with existing fact 006 (July 1867). The article mentions Allen's 'departure' from St. Louis without saying where.
